published.en: Participants must be at least 16 years old AND live in the neighborhood. Registration must be received on or before 5 November 2026 at 18:00 UTC.
published.es: Para participar, hay que tener al menos 16 años Y residir en el barrio. La inscripción debe recibirse a más tardar el 5 de noviembre de 2026 a las 18:00 UTC.

alice.text: Participation policy. An applicant is eligible exactly when they are a resident and at least 27 years old. Age means completed whole years at the recorded submission timestamp. The application system must record the submission at or before 2027-08-21T06:20:00Z (UTC), including that exact instant. Acceptance requires eligibility and compliance with this deadline. There are no other conditions or exceptions.

bob.text: Política de participación. La edad se mide en años completos en el instante de presentación registrado. Se excluye por elegibilidad a toda persona que tenga menos de 27 años o que no sea residente. Quienes no estén excluidos por esa regla deben, además, tener al menos 23 años completos para ser elegibles. El sistema debe registrar la presentación a más tardar el 2027-08-21T06:20:00Z (UTC), incluido ese instante exacto. La aceptación exige elegibilidad y cumplimiento del plazo. No hay otras condiciones ni excepciones.

candidates.en: Participation policy. Age is measured in completed whole years at the recorded submission timestamp. Anyone who is younger than 27 or is not a resident is disqualified on eligibility grounds. Those who are not disqualified by that rule must also be at least 23 completed years old to be eligible. The system must record the submission no later than 2027-08-21T06:20:00Z (UTC), including that exact instant. Acceptance requires eligibility and compliance with the deadline. There are no other conditions or exceptions.
